fields.name: national_certification_required
fields.description: Whether the applicant must hold current certification from a nationally recognized credentialing body (e.g., Board of Certification Inc.) as a condition of licensure.
fields.sample_quote: is in good standing with and provides documentation of current certification by the Board of Certification Inc. or a nationally recognized credentialing agency approved by the board

fields.name: certifying_body_name
fields.description: Name of the primary national credentialing organization whose certification satisfies the licensure requirement.
fields.sample_quote: the certification examination administered by the Board of Certification Inc.

fields.name: supervising_clinician_types
fields.description: Types of licensed clinicians who may serve as the directing or supervising authority over an athletic trainer's practice.
fields.sample_quote: "Directing physician" means a physician and surgeon... an osteopathic physician and surgeon... a chiropractic physician... a naturopathic physician... or dentist

fields.name: supervision_order_types
fields.description: Forms of direction or orders through which a supervising clinician may authorize athletic training services.
fields.sample_quote: A directing physician shall provide direction to an athletic trainer by a verbal order when in the presence of the athletic trainer and by written order or by athletic training service plans or protocols when a directing physician is not present.

fields.name: service_plan_or_protocol_required
fields.description: Whether athletic training services must be carried out under established written service plans or protocols when the directing clinician is not present.
fields.sample_quote: by written order or by athletic training service plans or protocols when a directing physician is not present

fields.name: patient_population_definition
fields.description: Statutory definition of the population an athletic trainer is authorized to serve, including any non-athlete roles covered.
fields.sample_quote: "Athlete" means an individual, referee, coach, or athletic staff member who participates in exercises, sports, or games requiring physical strength, agility, flexibility, range of motion, speed, or stamina

fields.name: authorized_therapeutic_modalities
fields.description: Specific therapeutic modalities explicitly enumerated in statute as within the athletic trainer's scope of practice.
fields.sample_quote: administering therapeutic exercise and therapeutic and physical modalities, including cryotherapy, thermotherapy, and intermittent compression, electrical stimulation, ultra sound, traction devices, or mechanical devices

fields.name: return_to_play_authority
fields.description: Whether the athletic trainer is explicitly authorized to determine an athlete's readiness to return to participation.
fields.sample_quote: determine whether an athlete may return to participation or, if the injury requires further definitive care, refer the athlete to the appropriate directing physician

fields.name: adequate_records_components
fields.description: Minimum required elements that must appear in an athletic trainer's client records as defined by statute.
fields.sample_quote: "Adequate records" means legible records that contain, at a minimum: (a) the athletic training service plan or protocol; (b) an evaluation of objective findings; (c) the plan of care and the treatment records; or (d) written orders.

fields.name: preparticipation_screening_authorized
fields.description: Whether the athletic trainer is explicitly authorized to perform preparticipation physical screening.
